'''Skali Speederz Rulez''' is a [[Light]] constructed list [[Skali]] published on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]].<ref name="or">[http://www.geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/expandeduniverse/SpeederRulez.htm Speederz Rulez], The Outer Rim (Skali). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20091027155336/http://geocities.com/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/expandeduniverse/SpeederRulez.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Skali]]
* '''Published:''' by 12 May 2001 (The Outer Rim)
* '''Published title:''' ''Speederz Rulez''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor Speederz Rulez Skali LS 2001.txt |Download]] (omits Wise Advice (Reflections III: A Collector's Bounty): not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' Speederz Rulez

== Introduction ==

Skali posted this Expanded Universe speeder list on The Outer Rim. The published objective line is Agents in the court. The published list has 59 cards.
